title: Duplicate CGM data as the readings , in virtual pump and data coming from Knighscout not via xdrip
symptom: Running AndroidAPS 3.0-rc1 in virtual mode with a Medtronic 722, CGM data coming from Knightscout, user sees duplicate CGM readings that are very close multiple times, and is concerned about a red triangle.
cause: The BG source (Knightscout) is providing duplicated readings, which is not a bug of AAPS.
fix: Resolve the issue on the BG source; avoid using NS as BG source and send BG directly to AAPS to avoid internet dependency.
evidence_quote: AAPS is just telling you your bg source has duplicated readings. it's not a bug of AAPS
